A2_BALL_CONTROL.definition: Ball(k)={cell IDs at A2 graph distance <=k from O}

A2_SECTOR_CONTROL.definition: Sector(k)={(i,j):i>=0,j>=0,i+j<=k} in a named A2 sector chart

A2_SHELL_CONTROL.definition: S(k)={cell IDs at A2 graph distance exactly k from O}

M_FOLD_CARTESIAN_LEVEL_CARRIERS.meaning: m independent integer level slots only

hard_anti_circularity: no carrier region defined from desired jump schedule and then equated to n without an independent map
no post-hoc ordering of carrier states
no nearest/floor/ceil/midpoint before a count semantics is independently selected

predeclared_gap_allocation_semantics.ACTIVATED_LAYER: move to upper layer when its first new state is activated
predeclared_gap_allocation_semantics.COMPLETED_LAYER: remain at lower completed layer until the next carrier is fully completed
predeclared_gap_allocation_semantics.COUNT_BALANCED_REFLECTION: for consecutive capacities L<U, use reflection n->L+U-n and require monotone complementary allocation
